data.one_liner: Responsive floating TabBar with PageView for multi-platform Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides a floating or normal TabBar paired with a PageView, supporting responsive design across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux. Includes additional widgets like TopTabBar, Nautics sidebar, OpsShell, and more for complex navigation scenarios.
use_when: You need a floating TabBar that adapts to screen size
Your app requires a sidebar or top bar navigation with nested items
You want a single package that bundles multiple navigation widgets
avoid_when: You only need a simple bottom navigation bar
You prefer the built-in Flutter TabBar without extra widgets
Your project targets only mobile and you want minimal dependencies
strengths: Responsive design out of the box
Multiple navigation widgets in one package
Supports all major desktop and mobile platforms
weaknesses: Documentation is limited for some widgets
No support for Cupertino style navigation
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, import package, use widgets directly
